inverse.$description: Background of an element that inverts the surface it sits on.

surface.$description: The default surface content is read against.

surface-muted.$description: A surface that recedes behind content: inert areas, read-only regions.

surface-hover.$description: The surface of a hoverable element while a pointer is over it.

surface-strong.$description: The surface of a filled control that carries the primary action.

surface-strong-hover.$description: A filled control's surface while a pointer is over it.

accent.$description: The accent surface that marks selection and emphasis.

accent-hover.$description: The accent surface while a pointer is over it.

scrim.$description: The wash under a floating surface that dims the page behind it.

surface-pressed.$description: The surface of a pressed control: one step past hover.

surface-strong-pressed.$description: A filled control's surface while it is being pressed.

accent-pressed.$description: The accent surface while it is being pressed.

selected.$description: The surface of a row or an option that is chosen.

success.$description: The surface of a message that confirms something worked.

warning.$description: The surface of a message that asks for attention before something is lost.

info.$description: The surface of a message that adds context without asking for action.

default.$description: Body text and every label not deliberately quieter.

muted.$description: Supporting text: help, descriptions, secondary labels.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons read on an accent or strong surface.

error.$description: Text that names a failure or a destructive action.

on-selected.$description: The text of a chosen row or option, on `bg.selected`.

success.$description: The text of a confirmation, on `bg.success` or on a page surface.

warning.$description: The text of a warning, on `warning.bg` or on a page surface.

info.$description: The text of an informational message, on `info.bg` or on a page surface.

on-accent.$description: Borders drawn on an accent or strong surface.

default.$description: The border of a control at rest.

strong.$description: A border that reads as a boundary rather than a hint.

error.$description: The border of an invalid control.

subtle.$description: A divider, not a boundary: it separates without framing.

success.$description: The border of a confirmation surface.

warning.$description: The border of a warning surface.

info.$description: The border of an informational surface.

focus-halo.$description: The translucent ring drawn around a focused control.

focus-ring.$description: The opaque ring a focus indicator is drawn with.
